summary: RF-13 meets the formal workflow authority contract: protected external and high-risk operations require an exact scoped record, local reversible operations remain automatic, and semantic verdict values remain outside router synthesis.
findings: Typed approval is emitted without a matching record; an exact operation/state-scope/expiry match restores only the projected workflow operation.
Authority audit fixtures cover actor, policy rule, operation digest, state fingerprint, authority digest, outcome, and hash-chain tamper failure.
hidden_assumptions: The formal task route is the authority boundary; direct legacy command invocation is compatibility surface, not a separate authorization protocol.
residual_risks: The local hash-chain journal is tamper-evident but is not protected by a separate signing principal; beta.1 must add the external verifier/signer boundary.
